disposition_reason: The canonical registration explicitly includes behavioral model comparison, and the source provides an ordered BIC comparison, so this is source-unresolved rather than a newly invented prediction task. Exact original BIC values, likelihood/parameter-count semantics and code-to-paper correspondence remain unresolved. EEG association strength is not an ordered paper-win endpoint.

source_paper.title: The neural correlates of novelty and variability in human decision-making under an active inference framework

evidence.locator: Version-of-record cover; pp. 6-7 Behavioral results/Fig. 4c; pp. 19-20 Participants and EEG processing
evidence.supports: 120-trial behavioral fitting/BIC comparison; model parameter sets; fitting search; EEG processing and descriptive source correlations.
25 behavioral datasets versus 23 preprocessed EEG datasets; analysis and source-regression routes.

evidence.locator: Behavioral_Data, log_P_rl, Parameter_update_rl, active-inference forward functions
evidence.supports: Pinned fitting notebook contains task choice/reward parsing and model computations; visible exploratory cells do not alone establish publication-fit identity.
Behavioral comparison is explicitly canonical. Existing scorer is 25-person supplied-fit/forward conformance and excludes EEG, fresh optimization and held-out prediction claims.

target.description: Compare active-inference, model-free RL and model-based RL explanations of the original choices. Sensor/source EEG associations remain supporting descriptive outcomes; stronger significance cannot count as improved behavioral modeling.

dataset.description: FreeEnergyEEG supplies the experiment data and analysis notebooks; the task pins commit 80418e5d1949631b0e2b54432e6b6956773c43da. Exact publication-linked fit/data and EEG exclusion manifests are not bound.

cohort.description: 25 behavioral participants; the author repository separately describes 23 preprocessed EEG participants. These are modality-specific populations, not interchangeable cohort sizes. Exact EEG participant exclusions remain a mapping blocker.

split.description: Paper fits each participant across the original single block of 120 trials and compares BIC. No held-out predictive partition is reported for this comparison; a nested or held-participant evaluation is a separate extension.

inputs.description: Trial histories include cue availability, stay/cue choice, safe/risky choice, context and observed rewards. Preserve information available at each choice; EEG data and fitted source regressors are separate modalities.

preprocessing.description: Behavioral parser/likelihood masks and model initialization must match the publication. For EEG the paper specifies 250 Hz, 1-30 Hz, ICA and fsaverage/eLORETA; exact exclusions and preprocessing-to-trial mapping remain unbound.

metric.description: BIC is the published ordered metric. Freeze its exact likelihood, sample-size convention and effective parameter count before scoring; fitting-notebook output and supplied-fit forward error are not automatically Figure 4c BIC.

aggregation.description: Original participant-level BIC values and the exact Figure 4c cohort summary/uncertainty need recovery. Do not substitute a smaller participant set, an arbitrary pooled likelihood or a local reference discrepancy.

comparison.primary_metric: Original Figure 4c behavioral Bayesian information criterion (BIC), with original cohort and likelihood convention

published_baseline.description: Figure 4c compares BIC for the three models, but exact active-inference baseline values and summary formula were not recovered; no figure digitization or local conformance score is used.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: The existing 75-fit/25-conformance adapter checks supplied artifacts. It does not establish fresh optimization or exact reproduction of published BIC.

minimum_effect.rationale: A meaningful BIC improvement requires a valid declared likelihood/complexity convention and full cohort comparison; no universal BIC threshold or EEG p-value improvement is imposed.

uncertainty.method: Unresolved: predeclare paired participant-level candidate-minus-author BIC uncertainty and model-family multiplicity after recovering original score semantics.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Participant; trials, electrodes, source parcels and time points are nested observations.
uncertainty.rationale: Participants provide biological replication. In-sample model fit and descriptive EEG significance do not establish protected predictive improvement.

paper_win_requires: Recover original Figure 4c BIC values and the publication-compatible active-inference/RL likelihood, parameter-count and aggregation conventions.
Compare the complete original behavioral cohort on the same choice-estimation task, with all method-selection and public-exposure limits declared.
Keep the canonical EEG outputs as descriptive/calibration evidence; do not claim their larger correlations or smaller p-values are a paper win.
A new held-out predictive split or a 23-person behavioral subset is an extension, not a source-paper victory.
Predeclare candidate freeze, meaningful effect, uncertainty and fixed budgets; forward-conformance success alone is never scientific success.

current_sota.description: No current-SOTA comparison was source-verified; paper and rerun baselines are separate.

episode.improvement_loop: Blocked pending original BIC recovery and an admission design compatible with in-sample source fitting. Protected prediction on a new split may be useful but must be separately labelled.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze model family, free parameters, priors/initialization, likelihood masks and optimization/search rule before final original-task comparison.
episode.final_evaluation: Recompute original-cohort BIC against the recovered author result and report EEG calibration separately; do not replace Figure 4c by the supplied-artifact discrepancy grader.
episode.baseline_policy: Separate published BIC, an authentic author refit and local supplied-fit numerical conformance. Existing runtime seconds are not an authorized improvement-episode allocation.

blocking_issues: Exact published BIC baseline and participant-level summary are unrecovered.
Paper-versus-notebook likelihood, parameter count, search configuration and final-version identity need reconciliation.
The original fit uses exposed data; a scientifically valid protected iteration/admission policy is not established.
EEG exclusion/trial map and full canonical calibration coverage remain incomplete.
No meaningful-effect/uncertainty rule, original-task improvement evaluator or fixed episode budgets.

legacy.notes: Retain the historical 25-participant supplied-fit and forward-conformance adapter unchanged. It excludes EEG and cannot demonstrate fresh-fitting, stronger-than-paper performance or current SOTA.
